text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] spike in inference 503s detected for embed-service (region-us-east-1) - severity: sev2

maria: noticed increased 5xx and elevated p50/p95 on the embed route. Paging on-call now.

sam: on it. can you paste the alert query and the first error logs?
maria: alert: `sum(incidents.errors{service=\"embed-service\",code=\"503\"}) by (instance) > 5`
logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:02:12Z embed-service[replica-7]: kvcache miss spike, async refill queue saturated
2026-03-15T11:02:14Z embed-service[replica-7]: downstream grpc timeout 10s -> reply 503
```

tyler: i'm seeing high shm usage on replica-7 and a bunch of kvcache evictions. looks like hot-prefix churn.

jess: is this related to the recent batching change we rolled last week?
sam: possibly. rolling back batching config on that pool to baseline now.
deploy-bot: Deploy rollback triggered by sam: rollback config batch-size -> 64 on pool embed-pool-us-east-1 (job id: 20260315-453) :arrow_heading_down:

amanda: adding temporary rate limit on the external embedding route to protect downstream customers. set RL to 50rps for 30m.
maria: mitigation checklist so far:
- rollback batching patch on pool (sam)
- temporary rate limit (amanda)
- cordon replica-7 and drain (tyler)
- monitor p95 and error rate (maria)

sam: cordoned replica-7, started drain. commands run:
```
sudo nodectl cordon replica-7
sudo nodectl drain replica-7 --grace 60
```

tyler: after drain we observed error rate drop by ~72% in 4 minutes. p95 back to baseline.
jess: customer impact assessment? any impacted tenants?
maria: preliminary: ~18 distinct customers saw intermittent 503s over a 9-minute window. largest impact on `acme-inc` and `hawk-ai` (retries masked some errors). no billing anomalies reported yet.
amanda: opened support ticket for top 5 clients to proactively notify. ticket ids: SUP-8851, SUP-8852.
sam: passing to next on-call for extended monitoring and post-incident follow-up. tagging @tyler for handoff.
tyler: taking the handoff. summary pinned above. I'll keep monitoring for 2h.

--- Handoff / Post-incident plans ---
maria: ok team, we need a short postmortem and follow-ups. propose timeline:
- initial postmortem draft in 24h (owner: sam)
- full postmortem + timeline + root cause analysis in 72h (owner: jess)
- remediation tickets created and linked in postmortem (owner: tyler)

sam: I can do the initial timeline + mitigation steps. jess will lead root cause analysis since batching + kvcache interplay.
jess: will instrument additional metrics for KV cache churn and hot-prefix detection. planning to add:
- per-prefix eviction rate
- async refill queue depth per replica
- histogram of request prefix entropy
tyler: remediation items I'd expect:
- auto-heal: detect hot-prefix and spin a dedicated shard or increase cache size temporarily
- hard limit on async refill queue depth with backpressure
- safer rollback gating on config changes (jobs that change batching to auto-update flags)

amanda: ops ask: add a runbook entry for this specific symptom set (kv cache thrash -> 503s) and include the commands you ran. I'll own the runbook update.

sam: scheduling postmortem sync: propose Thu 16:00 UTC. can everyone make it?
maria: I can.
tyler: yes.
jess: yes.
amanda: yes.

--- Action items (tracked as individual tickets) ---
1) PMT-1201 create draft postmortem (owner: sam) - due in 24h
2) PMT-1202 RCA instrumentation & logs (owner: jess) - due in 72h
3) INF-3425 auto-heal proposal for hot-prefix (owner: tyler) - spec due 1 week
4) DOC-778 runbook entry + remediation steps (owner: amanda) - due 48h
5) SRE-ops alert tuning to catch early kvcache churn (owner: maria) - due 72h

jess: I'll link the relevant perf graphs and a small script to reproduce kvcache churn in the draft.
sam: will include timeline + mitigation in the initial draft and notify support so they can update customers.
amanda: i'll run the brown-bag session to share learnings once the postmortem is done. propose next Tue 09:30 PT. topic: "Preventing KV-cache thrash: patterns and autoscale".
maria: great — make it practical: include logs/queries, runbook walkthrough, and a demo of the auto-heal idea.
tyler: also recommend we include a short checklist for config rollouts that touch batching/queueing.
jess: can we add a short pre-shutdown test harness for new batching configs? small perf test that simulates prefix skew.
sam: good idea. I'll create a ticket for a rollout guard: ENG-9001.

--- Follow-ups during handoff ---
tyler: monitoring note: I left a dashboard pinned to the incident channel with p50/p95/error-rate + per-replica refill-queue. sam can you keep alerting thresholds soft for 1 day while we tune?
sam: will keep soft thresholds for 24h. logging retention for these traces extended to 7d for debugging.
amanda: support notified customers and uploaded a short incident summary to the support portal.

maria: final note before I sign off: good job getting rollback + RL in quickly. key takeaways for now: better rollout gating for batching changes, kvcache instrumentation, and a runbook for thrash. We'll capture more in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to MONITORING (owner: tyler) - incident closed for active mitigation.

jess: thanks all — I'll start the RCA instrumentation tonight and share links in the postmortem draft.
tyler: taking extended watch, will post any anomalies in this thread.
sam: closing my page, ping me if anything spikes.
amanda: adding brown bag invite in calendar (tentative).
